name: Druid Nature’s Muse
body:
A nature’s muse is a member of an organization committed to the preservation of nature’s diversity, with each member belonging to an order dedicated to a specific aspect of nature which serves as the inspiration for the muse’s magical inclinations.

Order

At 1st level, a nature’s muse selects an order which immediately grants a unique boon. Furthermore, the nature’s muse chooses one of the two spells listed as “novice” spells. This spell can be cast once per day as a spell-like ability with a caster level equal to the muse’s level.

This selection is permanent and cannot be changed. This replaces wild empathy.

Order of the Arachnid

Boon: A nature’s muse of this order gains a +1 bonus on Climb skill checks.

Novice: magic fang, web bolt

Adept: whip of spiders, web

Master: spider climb, communal, web cloud

Order of the Avian

Boon: A nature’s muse of this order gains a pair of feathery wings that are not strong enough for flight, but act to slow a fall, reducing the distance fallen by 20 feet.

Novice: commune with birds, winter feathers

Adept: eagle eye, wing bounty

Master: wing thorns, wooden wing shield

Order of the Currents

Boon: A nature’s muse of this order can hold its breath three times as long as normal.

Novice: touch of the sea, wave shield

Adept: slipstream, water walk, communal

Master: control water, ride the waves

Order of the Dunes

Boon: When making a Fortitude save in conditions of severe and extreme heat to determine the amount of non-lethal damage suffered, a nature’s muse of this order doubles the duration between required saving throws and gains a +2 bonus to those rolls.

Novice: cloak of shade, sun metal

Adept: fury of the sun, heat metal

Master: grove of respite, healing warmth

Order of the Green

Boon: A nature’s muse of this order gains a limited form of photosynthesis such that only 1/2 the typical daily nutritional requirements of food and water are needed to survive.

Novice: entangle, goodberry

Adept: climbing beanstalk, greensight

Master: green caressHA, thorn body

Order of the Infestation

Boon: A nature’s muse of this order gains a +2 bonus on saves against disease.

Novice: diagnose disease, remove sickness

Adept: pox pustules, sickening strikes

Master: fleshworm infestation, touch of slime

Order of the Night

Boon: A nature’s muse of this order gains the equivalent of a full night’s rest in 1/2 the normal amount of time.

Novice: restful sleep, sleep

Adept: darkness, dust of twilight

Master: darkvision, greater, vigilant rest

Order of the Predator

Boon: A nature’s muse of this order gains a +5 foot enhancement bonus to its land speed.

Novice: deadeye’s lore, hunter’s howl

Adept: acute senses, aspect of the bear

Master: aspect of the wolf, burst of speed

Order of the Scorpion

Boon: A nature’s muse of this order gains a +2 bonus on saves against poison.

Novice: delay poison, nauseating dart

Adept: accelerate poison, pernicious poison

Master: giant vermin, vermin shape ll

Order of the Tempest

Boon: A nature’s muse of this order gains resist electricity 3.

Novice: shock shield, shocking grasp

Adept: aggressive thundercloud, gusting sphere

Master: aggressive thundercloud, greater, ball lightning

Order of the Volcano

Boon: A nature’s muse of this order gains a +2 bonus to CMD to avoid bull rushes, overrun, and reposition attempts.

Furthermore, you count as being one size larger than your actual size for the purposes of these, i.e. if you’re size Medium, you count as size Large, and a Small creature cannot bull rush you.

Novice: stone fist, stone shield

Adept: groundswell, stone discus

Master: obsidian flow, volcanic storm

Adept (Sp)

At 2nd level (druid), 5th level (hunter), or 7th level (ranger), a nature’s muse chooses one of the two spells listed as “adept” spells. This spell can be cast once per day as a spell-like ability. Furthermore, the nature’s muse can use his novice spell-like ability one additional time per day.

This replaces woodland stride.

Master (Sp)

At 15th level (druid) or 17th level (hunter and ranger), a nature’s muse chooses one of the two spells listed as “master” spells. This spell can be cast once per day as a spell-like ability. Furthermore, the nature’s muse can use his adept spell-like ability one additional time per day.

This replaces timeless body (druid), one with the wild (hunter) and hide in plain sight (ranger).

Other Muses

The orders of the Nature’s Muse are not overly strict about whomever joins their ranks. Other classes, including bards, hunters, rangers, and skalds have become notable muses in their own right.

Order

At 1st level, all nature’s muses select an order and receives that order’s unique boon.

Bard: This replaces countersong.

Hunter: This replaces wild empathy.

Ranger: This replaces wild empathy.

Skald: This replaces Scribe Scroll.

Novice (Sp)

Bard: This is gained at 5th level and replaces loremaster.

Hunter: This is gained at 1st level.

Ranger: This is gained at 1st level.

Skald: This is gained at 6th level and replaces the rage power gained at that level.

Adept (Sp)

Bard: This is gained at 11th level.

Hunter: This is gained at 5th level and replaces woodland stride.

Ranger: This is gained at 7th level and replaces woodland stride.

Skald: This is gained at 12th level and replaces the rage power gained at that level.

Master (Sp)

Bard: This is gained at 17th level.

Hunter: This is gained at 17th level and replaces one with the wild.

Ranger: This is gained at 17th level and replaces hide in plain sight.

Skald: This is gained at 18th level and replaces the rage power gained at that level.

At 5th level, the nature’s muse chooses one of the two spells listed as novice spells for their order. This spell can be cast once per day as a spell-like ability with a caster level equal to the muse’s caster level. This selection is permanent and cannot be changed.

At 11th level, a nature’s muse can use their novice spell twice per day. They also choose one of the two spells listed as adept spells for their order. This spell can be cast once per day as a spell-like ability.

At 17th level, a nature’s muse can use their adept spell twice per day. They can also choose one of the two spells listed as master spells for their order. This spell can be cast once per day as a spell-like ability.

This ability replaces lore master.

Order of the Fens

Boon: A nature’s muse of this order gains a +1 bonus on Swim skill checks.

Novice: air bubble, mudball

Adept: grasping vine, sickening entanglement

Master: explosion of rot, slowing mud

Order of the Glacier

Boon: A nature’s muse of this order gains resist cold 1.

Novice: frostbite, snowball

Adept: frigid touch, winter’s grasp

Master: creeping ice, ice storm

*Special note: progression for a nature’s muse bard archetype follows a slightly different time frame (see the Other Muses sidebar on the previous page for details).
